BrandDescription.zhs: 统一业务运营与平台治理入口，提供清晰、稳定、轻量的企业级 Shell 体验。
BrandDescription.en: One place for business operations and platform administration.

BrandPortal.zhs: 统一进入业务门户与平台门户

BrandGovernance.zhs: 支持权限治理、配置管理与审计巡检

BrandFoundation.zhs: 为后续模块接入提供稳定的共享视觉基础

LoginDescription.zhs: 请使用现有账号凭据登录统一 Shell。
LoginDescription.en: Sign in with your existing account credentials.

RestrictedDescription.zhs: 当前临时会话只允许修改密码、查看当前账号或退出。完成后会自动建立普通会话。
RestrictedDescription.en: This temporary session only allows password changes, viewing your account, and signing out. Changing your password starts a regular session.

PasswordRules.zhs: 密码长度为 8–64 个字符，不能全部为空白，也不能与当前密码相同。
PasswordRules.en: Use 8–64 characters. The password cannot be entirely whitespace or the same as your current password.

PasswordMismatch.zhs: 两次输入的新密码不一致。
PasswordMismatch.en: The new passwords do not match.

DictionaryUnavailable.zhs: 界面词典暂时不可用。登录仍可使用，业务页面将在恢复后开放。
DictionaryUnavailable.en: Interface translations are unavailable. You can still sign in; business pages will be available after recovery.

SessionDescription.zhs: 当前登录状态无法验证，已保留本地主体；恢复服务后可安全重试。
SessionDescription.en: Your sign-in status could not be verified. Your local session is preserved; retry when the service recovers.

RuntimeUnavailable.en: Module runtime could not be loaded

RuntimeDescription.zhs: 本次模块快照未生效，页面没有进入部分加载状态。
RuntimeDescription.en: The module snapshot was not activated. Retry to load the complete workspace.
